description: Election Commission - G. A. S. Piyarathne was elected as the member of the Ward No. 12 Kottawa East of Maharagama Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Maharagama Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for declaring a new member elected to replace a deceased member, which falls directly under election-related matters and procedures.
